finalThemeContrast.contrastMethod: WCAG relative luminance: UI on computed shell; legend on computed legendBackground; scene controls share that fixed --cfd-bg surface. The transparent 3D canvas wrapper is not used as a text background.

browser.tooling: Dedicated Chromium CDP + already installed Playwright, production builds; no application test hooks or new dependency.
notes: Failed provisional tests were resolved as harness assumptions: root scrollWidth can be four pixels below innerWidth due scrollbars; legacy SVG parser sorts vertices, so a real crossed sketch exercises the warning; initial Ready HUD obscures pre-run pixel samples.
The exact-byte parity harness resets RNG immediately before30 steps; otherwise random signed-zero inlet values can differ even with zero disturbance. This is temporary browser instrumentation only.
No 2D stretching fix was invented: object-fit contain was validated through displayed/backing pixel bounds.
A final visual check found a legacy light-theme 3D shell mismatch; scoped override restores ordinary UI contrast while plot surfaces stay dark.

performance.interpretation: No frame-cadence regression observed; refresh limit and CPU variability prevent general speedup/headroom claims.

limitations: Chromium only, no physical-device or assistive technology validation.
3D remains qualitative; no validated SI, force coefficient or turbulence conversion was introduced.
Native PNG export does not composite the DOM legends.
Existing parser and Analysis styling limitations remain outside scope.
